services.title: Commercial Roofing
services.text: Stronghold Restoration & Roofing specializes in all types of roofing installation, including complex commercial roofing projects.

services.title: Storm Damage
services.text: Water is your roof’s main enemy, and heavy rain, combined with extreme winds can cause some serious long term damage.

services.title: Gutters
services.short: Gutters are essential for any structure with a sloped roof.
services.text: Gutters are essential for any structure with a sloped roof. A properly installed gutter system collects water and diverts it away from the structure.

services.title: After Storm Damage
services.text: You may need a complete roof replacement after a severe storm or recurring storms. Hurricane season can cause some serious damage.
body: Be sure to get a roof inspector out as soon as possible. It’s best to have a professional check for any cracks, dents, breakage or missing shingles.

services.title: Old or Poorly Built Roof
services.text: If a roof has been neglected without proper repair, it may be past the point of “no return”.
body: Getting a new roof is a big investment, but our team will walk you through every step in getting what’s best for you and your budget. Be sure to maintain your new roof so it can live out its full lifespan.

services.title: Roof Evaluation & Diagnostics
services.text: Our commercial roof evaluation and diagnostic services identify damage, leaks, and performance issues before they become costly problems.
body: Detailed inspections help property owners make informed decisions about repairs, restoration, or replacement.

about.title: About Stronghold Restoration and Roofing
text: At Stronghold Restoration and Roofing, our journey began with a simple yet powerful mission: to do better for homeowners. Our founder and owner, Patrick Balusek, recognized a gap in the roofing industry—homeowners deserved a trustworthy partner who could provide exceptional craftsmanship and reliable support throughout the entire process. In 2017, he brought his vision to life: a company that excels in quality and service, and fosters genuine relationships.

Since the beginning, Patrick has been hands-on, and his leadership and dedication have been instrumental in shaping our company’s culture and values. Under Patrick’s guidance, Stronghold Restoration and Roofing has grown into a reputable and respected name in the community. We pride ourselves on being more than just a roofing company; we are a trusted and reliable partner dedicated to serving our community.

Guided by integrity, excellence, and community, we make repairing and replacing roofs simple, affordable, and reliable. We believe every homeowner deserves peace of mind. From the moment you contact us, we prioritize your needs offering transparent communication, comprehensive inspections, and personalized solutions.
